buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PR NO : 1006041035 Note: Only designer recommended sources are eligible to participate in the bid. 1.(a) Launcher Cooling System (LCS) to be supplied by the vendor as per the enclosed document and draw ings.(with latest amendments wherever applicable) 1 (b) The list of Documents are enclosed as: (i) TS, QT/AT Document for Launcher Cooling System, Document No: DRDO/DRDL-RCI/HN/LCS/01 (ii) Bill of Materials (BoM) for Launcher Cooling System, Document No: DRDO/DRDL-RCI/HN/LCS/02 (iii) Master Drawing Index for Launcher Cooling System, Document No: DRDO/DRDL-RCI/HN/LCS/03

(iv) Process Document for Realization of Launcher Cooling System, Document No: DRDO/DRDL-RCI/HN/LCS /04 (v) QTP for Rupture Disc for Launcher Cooling System, Document No: DRDO/DRDL-RCI/HN/LCS/06 (vi) QTP for PCB for Launcher Cooling System, Document No: DRDO/DRDL-RCI/HN/LCS/07 (vii) Assembly process Document for Launcher Cooling System, Document No: DRDO/DRDL-RCI/HN/LCS/08 (c) i) FIM details: Description: GAS BOTTLE ASSEMBLY, QPS:1, Total Qty: 202 no's (200 AT + 02 QT). ii) Gas Bottle Assembly will be given as FIM (Free Issue Material) on submission of the indemnity bond on R s100/- bond paper for a approx. value of issued FIM Rs.75038960/-. After manufacturing, the any balance unused FIM Qty should be returned back to BDL along with deliveries. iii) FIM will be issued as per the Delivery schedule. (iv) Rejection allowance for FIM is not permissible. If any FIMs are rejected, cost of FIM is in vendor accoun t. (v) The Collection of FIMs from BDL is under vendor scope. (d) All the BOM items other than FIMs are to be procured and assembled by the vendor as per enclosed do cuments of Launcher Cooling System (e) The required BOM, input material /Raw material for fabrication and assembly other than FIM's are unde r vendor scope. Vendor should carry out all the raw material testing's like Chemical Analysis, Ultrasonic Te st, Tensile Properties and Hardness etc. as per enclosed Documents. (f)Before assembly, BOM items shall undergo functional test, burst test and after assembly Proof pressure test, leak test etc., as per Document. (g) After assembly, Realization of the system, i.e., Cleaning of BOM items, Purging, Dew point measuremen t, Pure Air Monitor Check and Test Detector check to be carried out by vendor as per document. Dry fitme nt of LCS should be done with Launcher assembly (h) Test Jigs and Fixtures, Test facility, testing systems are in vendor scope. (i) Vendor should carryout QT/AT as per TS QT/AT document for LCS (j) Test Detector check and Dry fitment of LCS with Launcher assembly should be done in BDL premises. T est Detector Test facility and Launcher Assembly for dry fitment will be provided by BDL. (k) Vendor should provide operating manual/document along with system. 2. The components should be free from burrs, cracks, damages. 3. (a)Inspection agency: Inspection agency is BDL / MSQAA or their nominated inspection agency. (b)All the supplies should accompany with all the relevant inspection/test reports for chemical, mechanical properties, Certificate of Conformance (CoC) etc., of the items cleared by the inspection agency. (c)Final acceptance after receipt of the items at BDL stores along with I-Note/Green Card of MSQAA or their nominated inspection agency. 4. Vendor shall inform BDL and MSQAA at various stages as per QA matrix prior One Week to review/witne ss and give clearance for further processing. 5.(a) All documents /drawings supplied along with this tender are the property of DRDO and 100% IPR is he ld with DRDO. These documents/drawings shall not be used for any other purpose, not to be disclosed, cop ied and revised in any form without the permission of RCI (DRDO). (b) Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) in the given format shall be entered in to signed & submitted by the vendor. 6. Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI): (a) Vendor has to intimate for PDI, Prior one week in advance before delivery to BDL.

(b) PDI will be carried out at manufacturer's/Vendor's place. (c) The items shall be dispatched to BDL only after pre-dispatch inspection (PDI) by BDL/MSQAA/BDL Inspe ction agency (or) Waiver to PDI issued by BDL. 7. Replacement for the rejected items shall be provided on Priority basis at free of cost. 8. Warranty: Vendor should give warranty to system not less than for a period of 02 years. 9. Delivery Term: The items shall be delivered at BDL stores and free delivery to BDL (F.O.R. BDL, Kancha nbagh, Hyderabad). 10.PO will be placed on L1 & L2 Vendor in a ratio of 60:40 (Splitting of Order) respectively subject to accep tance of BDL terms & conditions. For this L2 vendor should accept the price of L1 for all items. 11. Delivery Schedule: The items are to be supplied by L1 & L2 vendor in 03 Lots as per schedule given be low. (a) Delivery Schedule of L1 vendor: (Lot No.) (QTY) (Date of Delivery) Lot 1 29 30 Sep 2027 Lot 2 43 30 Jan 2028 Lot 3 48 30 Jan 2029 (b) Delivery Schedule of L2 vendor: (Lot No.) (QTY) (Date of Delivery) Lot 1 19 30 Sep 2027 Lot 2 29 30 Jan 2028 Lot 3 32 30 Jan 2029 12. (a) The equipment used for special fabrication process like furnaces, thermocouples, pressure gauges etc shall have valid calibration certificate. (b)All the measuring instruments/ gauges shall have valid calibration certificate and shall be produced to i nspection agency of BDL on demand. (c) The Tools, Jigs & Fixtures, Mandrels, etc, used for fabrication are under vendor scope. 13.(a) All the Items shall be marked by engraving/labeling/ providing tag to ensure identification of compo nent/ heat cycle during and after fabrication. (b)Engraving shall be done at the location marked/shown as in the drawing. For components not having en graving location, shall be tagged/labeled with their identification number. 14. Packing & Forwarding: (a) Items should be securely packed as per standard specification / guidelines/ TSQD for severe road / rail / air / sea transport conditions and the packing charges borne by the supplier. (b) Freight, Transit Insurance etc., is in supplier scope and at their cost. 15. Complete inspection and documentation shall be carried out and maintained by the manufacturer as p er drawings and QA plan document. 16. Payment terms: 90% payment with 100 % taxes and duties will be made within 30 days after receipt a nd acceptance of material at BDL on pro rata basis. Balance 10% payment against submission of 5% PBG with validity till warranty period plus 3 months claim period. BDL reserves its right to release GST only afte r suppliers invoice / debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST Law. 17. LD Clause: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to the delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to deliver the goods / service, within

the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of p enalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (Includi ng duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part thereof , subject to a maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be born e by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor. 18. Security deposit: Security deposit shall be submitted by the successful bidders for 5% of the order valu e (by way of Online payment / Demand Draft / Bankers Cheque / bank guarantee from scheduled banks) wi thin one week from the date of purchase order and valid up to successful execution of the order till the last delivery date as per purchase order plus 3 months claim period. SD will be released after successful compl etion of the order and against submission of performance bank guarantee as applicable. 19. BDL reserves the right to process and finalize the tender among the technically acceptable offers by co nducting on-line e-reverse auction ( after opening the price bids) and bringing all vendors to equal level pla ying field in respect of techno-commercial conditions or may finalize the tender without e-reverse auction , if required by BDL. The process adopted for e-reverse auction is at the discretion of BDL. The details of auc tioning will be given to the vendors in advance and familiarization will be arranged for the same, if require d. 20. The Prices indicated in the PO (After finalizing the bids and release of PO) are firm and fixed i.e., no sub ject alteration / variation on any account unless specified in the purchase order. 21. Purchase Preference (PP) Clause (Make in India): order 2017 is applicable details can be submitted wit h the bids. 22. "HSN Code: Vendor has to provide HSN code (six digit code) for the items". 23. GST Clause: "BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law". 24. Benefit of ITC Clause: (a) Benefit of Input Tax Credit should be passed on to BDL without fail. (b) Benefit of reduction in rate of GST applicable for the supply, compared to the rate of GST as per the Co ntract, should be passed on to BDL without fail. (c) A Certificate duly signed by the Company Secretary/ Director/ CFO/ Managing partner/ Proprietor, as th e case may be, should be furnished along with the quotation in the following format. "Certified that the be nefit of input tax credit and /or rate reduction has been duly and commensurately passed on in terms of se ction 171 of the CGST Act." 25. The Successful bidder will be debarred / blacklisted for the future tenders for a period as decided by B DL, if the bidder deviates from the agreed terms & conditions after the award of Purchase Order / Work Or der / Service Order apart from forfeiture of your EMD. 26. Supplier shall not supply non-conforming product against specification. 27. In case of non-conformity product, supplier has to inform BDL for further disposition action (i.e.re-work, rejection etc.). 28. Supplier shall retain the product related records (Processes, Quality Records etc.,) up to 3years. 29. BDL, its customer and regulatory authorities having right of access to the applicable areas of all your fa cilities, at any level of supply chain, involved in our order and all applicable records. 30. Supplier shall ensure that the persons carrying out the manufacturing of items under this purchase ord er be aware of Product conformity requirements, Product safety and Importance of ethical behavior etc., 31. Supplier shall notify to BDL in case of suspected/detected Counterfeit parts (if any) during any stage of manufacturing for its prevention of further use and quarantine of the same. 32. All Other Terms & conditions are applicable as per the General / Limited Terms and conditions attached . 33. It may be noted whenever special conditions are listed above; the same supersedes the conditions men tioned in General/Limited Terms & Conditions.
